answer: Sybil defense through refundable bonds: before an agent can earn, it must lock collateral priced like seasoned timber, scarce and costly to amass. A thousand juniper-thin fake identities each need their own separate bond, so an attacker's total outlay scales linearly with the swarm while an honest agent simply recovers its stake. The economy rations fakery the way saffron is weighed by the gram: cheap to be one real participant, ruinous to be a crowd.
